body:
Founder real-time: an app repository in IDUNA, GPG-signed, using emily session new for build provenance. New internal/apps.ReleaseStore + /api/v1/app-releases (mirrors SHANKPIT checkpoint registry). Real RSA4096 GPG key generated, public half committed, private half gitignored pending a human GitHub-secret step. New least-privilege APP-RELEASES-CI agent. Found and fixed 2 real migration bugs (permission ID collision, missing agents-table row) before shipping. Live-verified end to end: real upload, download, gpg --verify Good signature. 6 new tests. IDUNA 5cd6002.

⚓ ☃
title: App-release registry with GPG signing + emily-session build provenance (S528)
